feed.headline: French weekend protests to be limited to union demos only, says Macron
feed.ai: Some cities including Lyon and Nice have banned all protests, and the French president said only authorised demos would be allowed.

feed.headline: Anti-terror police investigate as one person killed in shooting near Paris
feed.ai: French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu describes the gun attack in Trappes as "very serious".

feed.headline: Why a student protest movement is challenging 12 years of Vučić rule in Serbia
feed.ai: After two years of student protests, Serbians vote on Sunday in elections that could bring down the ruling party.

feed.headline: Rosenberg: Russia agrees to Ukraine talks but sees little to talk about in new peace push
feed.ai: President Vladimir Putin does not feel under pressure right now to end the war, the BBC's Russia Editor writes.

feed.headline: Are the French riots a warning of an intense election to come?
feed.ai: Rioting, looting and vandalism has gripped France over the weekend after protests spiralled out of control across the country.

feed.headline: In the Wake of Riots, the French Authorities Ban Some Protests
feed.ai: President Emmanuel Macron said the move was necessary “so that calm prevails.”

feed.headline: Serbian Election Underscores the Region’s Long Political Limbo
feed.ai: Aleksandar Vucic, Serbia’s dominant political figure since 2012, may extend his grip, using the Balkans’ unresolved nationalist resentments.

feed.headline: Macron Says Trump Does Not Like France and Distorts Its Troubles
feed.ai: Speaking in Qatar, President Emmanuel Macron railed against foreign leaders who he said had made false claims about unrest in France for their own political ends.

feed.headline: EU-Canada 'love story' needs more than warm words, senior MEP warns
feed.ai: European Parliament’s point man on Canada, Tobias Cremer, told Euronews that the planned “associate membership” should include an institutional framework formalising closer ties between the EU and Canada.

feed.headline: How migration is reshaping the political debate in Spain's Ceuta
feed.ai: The arrival of tens of thousands of migrants in Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta has fuelled political tensions ahead of next month's election.

feed.headline: Families of missing Azerbaijanis call for support from European institutions
feed.ai: Families of more than 4,000 Azerbaijanis still missing since the first Karabakh war brought their demand for answers to the EU institutions, hoping that the peace process between Armenia and Azerbaijan, after decades of suffering on both sides, could finally clarify the fate of their relatives.
